title: OAuth discovery is either proved or recorded as documentation-only, and never implied
statement: Either a fabricated OAuth credential is shown to make a BUILT-IN provider model available through the supported discovery surface, or a single manual run against a real subscription is retained as sanitised single-instance evidence labelled as such. Until one of those exists, no acceptance criterion and no section of the specification states the OAuth route as verified, and QST-0033 remains open and blocking.
